context: Tests MCP-first source resolution from a DOI and the rule that tangential papers are triaged and flagged rather than skipped.

checklist.name: MCP used for the DOI
checklist.description: Resolves the DOI through the semantic-scholar MCP (or google-scholar) rather than a raw HTTP fetch

checklist.name: WebFetch not used first
checklist.description: Does not fetch the publisher or arxiv page while an MCP can answer

checklist.name: Fallback order respected
checklist.description: Mentions google-scholar as the next source if semantic-scholar returns nothing

checklist.name: Duplicate check done
checklist.description: Searches REVIEWED.md and REFERENCE_INDEX.md before creating files

checklist.name: Slug follows convention
checklist.description: Uses a <firstauthor-surname>-<topic> slug derived from the resolved metadata

checklist.name: Paper is triaged not skipped
checklist.description: Creates references/<slug>.md even though the paper is tangential

checklist.name: Scope concern flagged
checklist.description: States clearly that the paper is off-topic for prompt compression and why

checklist.name: Frontmatter present
checklist.description: The reference file opens with a --- YAML block including type: reference and the paper tag

checklist.name: Unused sections marked N/A
checklist.description: Mechanism overview subsections that do not apply are marked N/A rather than left blank

checklist.name: No invented metrics
checklist.description: Evaluation numbers, if any, are quoted from the source and marked (as reported)

checklist.name: Disposition pending
checklist.description: REVIEWED.md records the paper as pending and no ANALYSIS file is created

checklist.name: Promotion choice offered
checklist.description: Ends by offering promote, keep or skip
